name: Merchant’s coat
description: Good cloth, brass buttons, plenty of pockets. Looks as if it has never been caught short.
notes: Clothes: a fine coat for the well-off. Weight 2.5 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, clothes 20-80 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
